A placeholder is written in double braces: {{name}}, {{name:argument}} or {{name:argument option=value}}.
A note for the editor of the template is written {{# like this }}. It is not written to the page.

  meta                  the character set, the viewport and the generator tags, for the head
  csp                   the security policy of the page. It allows the one script of the report and
                        loads nothing from the network. Leave it out only if your template needs its
                        own scripts or files
  style                 the style sheet of the report, written into the page. Add your own style
                        after it to change colours or fonts
  script                the small script of the report: the filter, the theme switch and the
                        contents highlight
  bar                   the bar at the top with the project name, the filter and the theme switch
  toc                   the contents list, made from the parts that you place
  footer                a last line with the tool and the fingerprint. The standard template leaves
                        it out, because the appendix lists both
  cover                 the whole cover: title, facts, figures, counts and statement
  cover.title           the title and the description of the project
  cover.facts           the item, the standards, the assessors and the date
  cover.stats           the headline figures: how many risks there are at each level before and with
                        the controls, the goals, the open items and the rules
  cover.counts          how many assets, damage scenarios, threat scenarios, attack steps and
                        controls there are
  cover.statement       the sentence that says the report is material for a review
  title                 the name of the project (text)
  description           what the project assesses and why (text)
  date                  the date of the assessment (text)
  standards             the standards, separated by commas (text)
  assessors             the assessors, separated by commas (text)
  item                  the name of the item (text)
  tool                  the name and version of assess (text)
  fingerprint           the SHA-256 fingerprint of the files the report was made from (text)
  risk.base             the risk of the item before any control (text)
  risk.residual         the risk of the item with the controls (text)
  open                  the number of open items (text)
  iteration             the iteration your treatment decisions are at, for example 2, finalized on a
                        date and time, or 3 in progress. It is none until you finalize one (text)
  iteration.hash        the hash of the last finalized iteration, or none (text)
  section:<id>          a part of the report with its heading, text, tables and sub-parts, for
                        example section:risk. omit=a,b leaves some of its sub-parts out. hide=a,b
                        leaves columns out of its tables. A name is left out of every table that has
                        it. part.name is left out only of the tables of that part. assess template
                        -list <project> shows the columns

The parts that section:<id> can place in this project (a part brings its sub-parts):
  project                        Project information
    project-sources              Sources
    project-extra-1              Disclaimer
    project-extra-2              Scope
    project-extra-3              Responsibilities
    project-extra-4              Status of this model
  item                           Item definition
    functions                    Functions
      columns: name, inside, description, flow
    architecture                 Architecture
      components                 Components
        columns: name, inside, properties, description
      interfaces                 Interfaces
        columns: name, inside, exposure, entrypoint, properties, description
      channels                   Channels
        columns: name, between, entrypoint, properties, description
      data                       Data
        columns: name, inside, over, properties, description
      transfers                  What travels over the channels
        columns: from, to, data, statedin
    assumptions                  Assumptions
      columns: statement, why, reliedon
  method                         Method and rules in force
    method-feasibility           Feasibility: points, levels and combination
    method-impact                Impact: how it is combined
    method-risk                  Risk: matrix and scalability
  tara                           Threat analysis and risk assessment
    assets                       Assets and cybersecurity properties
      columns: name, type, properties
    damage                       Damage scenarios and impact ratings
      columns: name, description, compromises, impact, causedby, decides
    threats                      Threat scenarios
      columns: name, description, asset, property, damages, steps
    steps                        Attack steps
      columns: name, description, target, scalability, actors, preparedby, mitigatedby, rationale,
               time, expertise, knowledge, window, equipment, total, level
    attacktrees                  Attack trees
    feasibility                  Attack feasibility
      columns: basefeasibility, basepath, residualfeasibility, residualpath
    risk                         Risk values
      columns: baserisk, basedecidedby, residualrisk, residualdecidedby, type, damage, impact,
               basefeasibility, residualfeasibility
    treatment                    Risk treatment decisions
      columns: name, type, baserisk, residualrisk, treatment, rationale, reference, description,
               status
  goals                          Cybersecurity goals and claims
    columns: name, baserisk, residualrisk, treatment, rationale, reference, description
  concept                        Cybersecurity concept: controls
    columns: name, description, target, mitigates, threatenedby, rationale, counted, time,
             expertise, knowledge, window, equipment, total, level
  appendix                       Appendices
    trace                        Traceability
      columns: threat, damages, steps, controls, risk, treatment
    worksheets                   Derivation worksheets
    open                         Open items
    iterations                   Iterations
    files                        Files read
